messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PagerDuty PD-7521 fired: inference-gateway (us-west2) 5xx rate spike.
incident-bot: Summary: 5m error rate 6.2% (>3% threshold). Affected route: /v1/generate. Heatmap: 00:12-00:17 UTC.
alice_ops: acked. i'm on it :wave:
pagerduty: PD-7521 acknowledged by alice_ops (on-call).
bob_oncall: i'll take lead for triage. checking ingress -> routing rules, can someone paste recent autoscaler events?
carla_sre: looking now. sending kvcache and pod status.
carla_sre: ```
W 2026-03-17T00:12:03 inference-pool-6 kernel: OOM killed process model-worker (pid 4821)
E 2026-03-17T00:12:15 kvcache: eviction_count=1245 latency_ms=4.3
```
dave_support: customer-impact: CS reports spike in errors for customer acct: ad-platforms (tickets: 7891, 7892). approx 40% failed requests seen in last 15m.
elena_pm: @bob_oncall any ETA on mitigation? customers are pinging success teams.
bob_oncall: applying routing fallback to smaller model variant to reduce memory pressure. running:

```bash
$ rtctl set-route /v1/generate model_variant=fallback-small region=us-west2
```

deploy-bot: route update initiated: /v1/generate -> fallback-small (us-west2).
infra-bot: autoscaler request queued: add 2 gpus to inference-pool-6; reason=OOM spikes. ETA ~90s.
carla_sre: after fallback, kvcache evictions dropping, new metrics look better. error rate moving from 6.2% -> 2.1% (1m window).
bob_oncall: confirm rollback not needed. i'll keep traffic on fallback for 15m and monitor. coordinating with infra to stabilize nodes.
alice_ops: updating PD with customer-impact note and status.
pagerduty: PD-7521: updated by alice_ops: fallback routing applied; infra scaling in progress; CS notified.
dave_support: opened high-priority communication with ad-platforms; providing them the fallback link and ETA.
elena_pm: thanks — please add a short note for customer comms with expected SLO restoration time.
bob_oncall: plan: 1) maintain fallback route 2) scale up pool +2 gpus 3) investigate root cause (model memory regression or kernel update). I'll post a full incident summary in 30m.
carla_sre: adding logs to the incident channel: suspected memory leak in model-worker after last quantization push.
alice_ops: next update at 00:25 UTC or earlier if significant change. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
pagerduty: PD-7521 will auto-escalate to SRE lead if no update in 10m.
incident-bot: reminder: run post-incident eval checklist once incident closed.
bob_oncall: thanks team — leaving thread for now, ping me if errors resurface.
